posts.title: Cigognes
posts.description: Cigognes ( Stork Fusiliers ) Les Songes Drolatiques de Pantagruel: Woodcuts as game material. The Cigognes, a loose group of mercenaries also known as the Stork Fusiliers, are chiefly known for their garish helmets, their deadly accuracy with fusils-longues and thin curved swords, and the persistent rumor that they secretly eat human flesh. Cigognes are recruited exclusively from the Low Mountains

posts.description: Knights of St. Rasso ( Rassians, the Gallimaufry, Gallimaufers ) Les Songes Drolatiques de Pantagruel: Woodcuts as game material.
